findings.summary: syncDrawerButtons() omits MULTI_TF — drawer buttons never turn green after answering
findings.consequence: After a student answers a MULTI_TF question, the named syncDrawerButtons() function (called by updateAnswered() and showQuestion()) does not check for .multitf-btn.multitf-active, so the drawer navigation button never turns green. The toggleSoalDrawer() inline code at lines ~156-164 correctly includes hasMultiTf but only fires when the drawer is opened.
findings.correction: Add `var hasMultiTf = section.querySelector('.multitf-btn.multitf-active');` inside syncDrawerButtons() and include `|| hasMultiTf` in the `done` expression, matching the existing correct code in toggleSoalDrawer().

findings.summary: updateAnswered() runs before MULTI_TF state restore on page load — initial answered count too low and drawer buttons grey
findings.consequence: On page load for a resumed attempt with pre-existing MULTI_TF answers, updateAnswered() (line 1012) executes before the MULTI_TF restore loop adds multitf-active classes (~line 1063). The initial answered count excludes those questions and all MULTI_TF drawer buttons start grey.
findings.correction: Move the updateAnswered() call from line 1012 to after the MULTI_TF restore loop (after line ~1083), so multitf-active classes are set before the count and button state are computed.
